editorial.headline: Animal Traditional-Remedy Retail: Nationally Open, Blocked in Bali
editorial.standfirst: This animal-medicine retail activity is nationally open to foreign investment, but a foreign investor cannot register it as PMA in Bali today.
editorial.body:
A foreign investor cannot register this activity as a PMA business in Bali today. That is the local reality even though the activity is nationally open to foreign investment with a 100% foreign-ownership ceiling. The distinction matters: a national opening is not a Bali registration outcome. Bali’s record marks the activity as blocked on a risk-class basis, under a province-wide, permanent moratorium for PMA activity in Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI.

At its core, this is the retail trade in various kinds of traditional or natural medicines for animals. The record places veterinary pharmacies, animal-medicine depots, pet shops, poultry shops and animal-medicine stores within that activity. These named formats give the scope its practical outline: a retail undertaking centred on traditional and natural animal medicines. Its defining subject is the retail sale of those products for animals.

Registration is open across the stated scale range—Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar—so the record does not confine the activity to one size of operator. For founders, that range describes the classes able to register the activity; it does not dilute the central geographical constraint for PMA in Bali. The national setting is TERBUKA, and the listed national foreign-ownership ceiling is 100%. The stated national source is Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021.

The Bali block turns on the risk treatment recorded for the activity. At scale Besar, OSS risk is Low or Medium-Low on every scope, placing it within the Bali moratorium. The record dates that block to 13 May 2026. The provincial rule blocks all Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI for PMA, island-wide and permanently. National openness does not alter the current PMA-registration position in Bali: the activity remains unavailable there for PMA registration.
